skill.name: douyin-video-copy-extract
skill.description: Extract Douyin video descriptions and spoken transcripts through SocialDataX using a video link, share text, or video ID.
skill.summary: Submit Douyin transcription jobs, resume existing jobs, and organize returned text into copyable versions and concise summaries.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Of 54 static alerts, 53 are false positives involving Markdown, ordinary Chinese text, service links, or documented authentication. One alert covers real execution of an unpinned npm package; a separate semantic finding identifies polling without a deadline or attempt limit. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or reconnaissance in the supplied files; external package and service behavior was not verified.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples automatically execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify package provenance, and obtain approval before installation or execution with access to credentials.

remediation.issue: Nonterminal transcription jobs trigger polling without a deadline or maximum attempt count.
remediation.suggestion: Add a polling deadline and attempt limit, cap server-provided waits, and return the existing job ID when the budget expires.

semantic_findings.description: The workflow continues querying every nonterminal job and permits stopping only at completion, tool failure, or user request. A stalled service can consume unbounded requests and agent execution time.

content.user_title: Extract Douyin Video Copy and Transcripts
content.value_statement: Manually copying Douyin descriptions and spoken content takes time. This skill uses SocialDataX transcription jobs to collect returned text and organize copyable versions.
actual_capabilities: Submit transcription requests using a Douyin video URL, short link, share text, or video ID.
Resume existing transcription jobs by job ID without submitting the video again.
Check terminal status and retry guidance before presenting transcripts or explaining failures.
Organize returned video metadata, original descriptions, spoken transcripts, copyable text, and concise summaries.
Use the documented direct CLI or corresponding submission and lookup MCP tools.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient service balance.
Direct CLI use requires Node.js and npm; the external CLI package is not included in these files.
Results depend on service availability, accessible video resources, and returned fields; transcript accuracy is not guaranteed.
Supports Douyin extraction and job lookup, not account actions or automatic processing on other platforms.

use_cases.title: Recover Spoken Content
use_cases.description: Extract a spoken transcript and original description from an authorized Douyin video for later editing.

use_cases.title: Prepare Source Notes
use_cases.description: Collect returned video context and a concise text version while keeping missing metadata clearly marked.

use_cases.title: Resume Pending Work
use_cases.description: Continue an existing transcription job and deliver its result without creating duplicate submissions.

prompt_templates.title: Extract One Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the original description and spoken transcript from this Douyin link: [video link]. Use only returned information.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: process a single video link.

prompt_templates.title: Process Share Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the transcript from this Douyin share text: [share text]. Include available video context and mark missing fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: use pasted share text instead of a standalone URL.

prompt_templates.title: Resume a Job
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue transcription job [job ID] without submitting the video again. Report the transcript only after successful completion.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: continue a previously submitted task.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Structured Text Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Process Douyin video ID [aweme_id]. Return available metadata, original description, transcript, copyable text, and a concise version. Do not invent missing content. Limit polling to five minutes, then return the job status and ID.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: request structured results with an explicit polling budget.

output: Next action: Query the same job later. Do not submit the video again.

best_practices: Use videos you are authorized to process and keep the SocialDataX API key in the environment, not in prompts.
Approve and pin the external CLI package before execution, or use an already configured transcription MCP connection.
Reuse the returned job ID, set a polling budget, and publish transcript text only after successful completion.
anti_patterns: Submitting the same video repeatedly when a job ID already exists.
Inventing missing metadata or presenting unfinished job output as a completed transcript.
Pasting API keys into chat or sending sensitive share text without considering external processing.

faq.question: Which inputs can I use?
faq.answer: Provide a Douyin video URL, short link, share text, video ID, or existing job ID. Use one input type per request.

faq.question: What setup does the skill require?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and network access. Direct CLI use requires Node.js and npm; MCP use requires the corresponding tools.

faq.question: Does extraction run entirely on my computer?
faq.answer: No. The workflow submits transcription jobs through SocialDataX. The supplied files describe CLI and hosted MCP access, not a local transcription engine.

faq.question: What happens when a job is still processing?
faq.answer: Query the same job ID after the suggested wait. Set a polling limit and retain the ID when stopping before completion.

faq.question: Can I use it without service credits?
faq.answer: The service can return insufficient_balance. Stop repeated calls, check the provider billing page, and resume the existing job when appropriate.

faq.question: Will it log into or modify my Douyin account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow does not log in, post, like, comment, or modify accounts. The external CLI implementation was not included for verification.
